table_metadata.table_purpose: Master protocol schedule common to all disease states and ISAs: screening (V1, V2), randomisation (V3), double-blind treatment V4-V7, early discontinuation
table_metadata.notes: One label column (L=1); data columns at positions 2-9 (V1 -> 2 ... V7 -> 8, ED -> 9); the right-hand Notes column is not a schedule column (notes are annotations). Header and the Notes cell of the Visit Number row reprinted on pp.18-22, de-duplicated. Rows below the 'Participant Device' band are redacted (CCI) in the source.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band: 'Screening' (marker a) spanning V1-V2 and 'Double-Blind Treatment Period' spanning V3-V7; blank over ED. Study phases -> epoch. Label cell blank, name synthesised.

Second header band naming visits: 'Screening Visit for Master' (V1), 'Pre-Randomization Screening Visit' (V2), 'Randomization to ISA' (V3), blank over V4-V7, 'Early Discontinuation' (ED). Visit names -> visit. The label cell prints the table heading 'H0P-MC-CPMP Master Protocol' (the activity column's heading), so the name is synthesised.
Visit identifiers V1 (marker b), V2 (marker c), V3-V7, ED -> visit. The Notes cell of this row carries 'Visits after V7 may be specified in the ISA.' (n1).
Study week per visit: 'Up to -6 months' (V1), '-10 to -7 days for most participants' (V2), 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 (V3-V7), blank for ED -> week (two cells give a range in months/days, printed literally).

annotations.annotation_text: Screening assessments may be conducted at other time points prior to randomization if they reduce participant burden.

The site determines the half-life of each pain medication the participant is currently taking to schedule Visit 2. Visit 2 can be scheduled no earlier than 7 days prior to randomization at Visit 3 due to the required 7-day PDEP.
The 5-half-life washout period for pain medications must come before the required 7-day PDEP, resulting in a minimum of 10 days for most participants.
Visit 2 testing is optional for individuals who have completed these assessments within 60 days of Visit 1. If the tests are repeated, the most recent results will be used for I/E purposes.
The activities applicable to all disease states and interventions studied under the master protocol are described in the SoA below.
Visits after V7 may be specified in the ISA.
ISA-specific informed consent may occur after other V1 procedures and prior to beginning the medication washout if the ISA is not available at the time of initial screening.

Duration of washout is at least 5 half-lives of the longest half-life medication taken for pain. Recommended minimum washout duration is 2 days. If participants are not taking medication for chronic pain during screening, a washout is not required.
7-day minimum NRS data and rescue use medication collected daily at home post washout and prior to randomization.
Including age, gender, race, and ethnicity
Pulse rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, and temperature taken with participant in a sitting position.
Triplicate ECGs. Post randomization ECGs are included in each ISA.
Any events that occur after signing the ICF are considered AEs as defined in Section 10.3.
Preexisting conditions not identified at V1 and started prior to signing the ICF should be recorded.
V2 procedure should be repeated if >60 days from V1
Collected daily with a take-home device. Compliance reviewed at each clinic visit.
Total quantity from any source, collected daily with a take-home device. Compliance reviewed at each clinic visit. See Section 6.5. for usage guidance.
At V1, use the C-SSRS Baseline version.
All subsequent assessments will use the C-SSRS Since Last Visit version.
Complete 1 form for each event identified on the Self-Harm Supplement form.
Post randomization collections will be defined in each respective ISA.
For women of childbearing potential.
V2 test is optional if within 30 days of V1 procedure
Collected at screening visit for all participants and by investigator discretion after V1.
